notes.title: The game is Live and out of Early access.
notes.content:
[b]Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year to you![/b]


Some of the highlights of this build are:

* There are more world in the first build than early access.
* Changes in dream access. 
* Fixed a minor flickering of fade effect in main menu area.
* Color gate dream colors now are more lively and close to primary colors.
* Other small improvements and fixes.

A planned surprise for next year with more promised achievements. 
Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Upcoming update!
notes.content:
Here we are after a long wait. The update that we mentioned on our social network is ready and needs a bit polishing and testing. Should be ready in few days to go. 
Some of the highlights that we did like to mention are:

* Brand new world Color Barrier with its own appealing music.
* Story line 
* Difficulty Adjustments to previous worlds
* Mechanism improvement for better gameplay.
* Other fixes.
